Kitchen Storage & Pantry Remodeling

KITCHEN STORAGE REMODELING

Kitchen Storage & Pantry Remodeling

Make room for the way you cook, shop and gather. Rohrer for Construction plans and builds kitchen storage improvements, from better cabinet organization to a redesigned pantry, for homeowners across Lake and nearby McHenry County. We have served local homeowners since 1989. Request a free estimate to discuss your kitchen.

Request a Free Estimate
See Our Projects
Written by Rohrer for Construction | Serving Lake County, IL since 1989 —
Last reviewed/Updated: October 2026
Storage planned around your kitchen

Kitchen storage remodeling can be a focused update or part of a broader kitchen renovation. We look at how the room is used, what needs a home and where storage is hard to reach. The goal is to make everyday items easier to put away and find without adding clutter to counters.

Options may include replacing cabinets, adjusting cabinet layouts, adding drawer storage, fitting pull-out shelves, creating a pantry cabinet or improving an existing pantry with new shelving. For a larger change, storage planning can be included in a complete kitchen remodeling project.

The right scope depends on the condition of the existing cabinets, available wall space, appliance locations and whether plumbing or electrical work is part of the plan. We discuss those details before construction so you can compare practical options rather than choose storage pieces in isolation.

Cabinet and drawer layouts suited to daily cooking and cleanup
Pantry shelving or cabinet storage sized to the available space
Finish and hardware selections that coordinate with the rest of the kitchen
Cabinets, pantry options and materials

A pantry can be a dedicated closet, a bank of tall cabinets or a combination of shelves and drawers. In a smaller kitchen, tall cabinetry can use vertical space while keeping frequently used items accessible. In a larger room, a walk-in pantry or reworked cabinet arrangement may be worth considering if the layout allows it.

Cabinet choices range from stock sizes to semi-custom and custom configurations. Interior features can include adjustable shelves, deep drawers, tray dividers and pull-out storage. Door styles, finishes, knobs and pulls help the new storage fit the kitchen’s overall look. For shelves, we can discuss durable finished surfaces and spacing based on the items you plan to store.

Countertops, backsplash, flooring and lighting may also be part of a wider remodel. If you are considering a full refresh, our project portfolio offers examples of completed work. Final material selections should suit your maintenance preferences and the conditions in the room.

Cabinet boxes and fronts selected for the project scope
Adjustable pantry shelves and drawer inserts
Hardware and finishes coordinated with existing or new surfaces
When better kitchen storage makes sense

Storage is worth addressing when cabinets are difficult to reach, shelves are poorly sized, pantry contents get lost or counters have become the default place for appliances and supplies. A remodel can also be a good time to correct storage that no longer suits a household’s routines or to plan for changing needs.

Many homes in the area were built from the 1950s through the 1990s, including ranches, split-levels and colonials. Their kitchen layouts and cabinet sizes can reflect the priorities of a different era. When we assess an existing kitchen, we consider its dimensions and conditions rather than assume modern cabinet sizes or a new layout will fit without adjustments.

Some homeowners want a targeted pantry renovation; others are already planning new cabinets, counters or a broader kitchen remodel. If the work changes walls, plumbing or electrical systems, permit needs may depend on the scope and the local jurisdiction. We coordinate permits for our projects and can help explain the steps; our permit resources outline what homeowners can expect.

Pantry shelves that no longer suit your groceries or small appliances
Cabinets with awkward access or wasted interior space
A kitchen renovation where storage needs to be planned with other work
A clear plan from first visit to finish

Storage work connects with the kitchen as a whole: cabinet dimensions affect clearances, and pantry placement affects how people move through the room. We review the existing conditions and intended scope before recommending an approach. For homeowners in McHenry, Richmond and nearby areas, Rohrer brings local project experience and manages permit coordination when permits are required.

A family-owned local contractor serving Lake County since 1989
A defined project scope before construction starts
Permit handling and coordination as needed for the work
Plan storage as part of a larger kitchen update

A storage improvement can be a standalone project, but it can also be coordinated with new cabinets, counters, flooring or other kitchen updates. Making those decisions together helps keep finish choices and construction sequencing aligned. For a preliminary discussion, use our project scope builder, or read about our general contractor services.

Permit requirements can vary by municipality and project details. For work in Lake County, consult the county’s building permit information and confirm which authority applies to your property. We can handle permit coordination for the work we undertake.

Each project varies by scope. These duration ranges are planning estimates, not a promised schedule; permit coordination may apply depending on the work involved.

Construction and Completion

Complete the planned kitchen remodeling work. The duration depends on the project scope and may vary.

Our kitchen storage remodeling process

We keep planning focused on your kitchen, the scope you want and the decisions that need to be made before work begins.

01
1. Talk through your needs

We discuss what is not working, what you want to store and whether you are considering pantry work alone or a broader kitchen remodel.

02
2. Review the existing space

We assess the kitchen’s dimensions, current cabinets, pantry area and relevant project conditions to understand what options fit.

03
3. Plan the scope and selections

We organize the layout, cabinet or shelving choices, finishes and related work. Permit considerations are identified based on the scope and jurisdiction.

04
4. Prepare for construction

We coordinate the project details and any required permits before construction begins, then review the work sequence with you.

05
5. Complete and review the work

Our team carries out the agreed scope and reviews the completed storage work with you.

The best solution depends on the kitchen’s layout and what you need within easy reach.

Pantry organization

Add or update shelves, improve access and plan storage around groceries, cookware and countertop appliances.

Cabinet interiors

Use drawers, pull-outs, adjustable shelves or dividers to make cabinet space more useful.

A broader cabinet plan

Coordinate pantry and cabinet changes with a larger remodel when existing storage is part of a wider layout problem.

KITCHEN CABINET INSTALLATION IN LAKE COUNTY, IL

Kitchen Cabinet Installation & Replacement

New cabinets can solve everyday storage problems, update a worn kitchen, or complete a larger renovation. Rohrer for Construction plans and installs kitchen cabinets for homes throughout Lake County and nearby McHenry County. We help you compare cabinet styles, materials, storage features, and layout options, then coordinate the work from planning through installation. We’re a family-owned local contractor serving the area since 1989. Request a free estimate to discuss your kitchen and the changes you want to make.

Request a Free Estimate
See Our Projects
Written by Rohrer for Construction | Serving Lake County, IL since 1989 —
Last reviewed/Updated: October 2026
What kitchen cabinet installation can include

A cabinet project starts with the room you have and the way you use it. Installation may include removing existing cabinets, preparing the walls and floor, setting new base and wall cabinets, fitting fillers and trim, and adjusting doors and drawers. Depending on the scope, we can also coordinate related work such as countertops, backsplash, lighting, flooring, or changes to the kitchen layout. Keeping these decisions connected helps avoid selecting cabinets that conflict with appliances, windows, or clearances.

Some homeowners need a focused cabinet replacement; others want cabinetry as part of a broader renovation. If the project involves more than cabinets, our kitchen remodeling service can help organize the full scope. We’ll discuss what should stay, what needs to change, and whether the existing arrangement can support the storage and working space you want.

Cabinet removal and installation planning
Base, wall, tall, and specialty storage cabinets
Door, drawer, hardware, trim, and finish selections
Coordination with other kitchen renovation work
Cabinet types, materials, and useful options

Cabinets are available in stock, semi-custom, and custom configurations. Stock cabinets use standard sizes and a defined selection of finishes. Semi-custom lines offer more choice in dimensions, door styles, and interior features. Custom cabinets allow greater flexibility when a kitchen has unusual dimensions or a specific design requirement. The right fit depends on your room, storage priorities, finish preferences, and project scope—not simply on choosing the most elaborate option.

Material choices can include solid wood, plywood, and engineered products such as medium-density fiberboard. Each has different characteristics, and construction details matter alongside the material name. Door styles range from simple slab fronts to framed and raised-panel designs. You can also consider painted or stained finishes, soft-close hinges and slides, pull-out shelves, drawer organizers, and pantry storage. We help you compare practical options and coordinate cabinet selections with counters, flooring, and backsplash finishes.

Choose a door style and finish that suit the home
Plan drawers, shelves, and pantry storage around daily use
Check cabinet dimensions against appliances and room clearances
Kitchen Cabinet Installation and Replacement Options

Rohrer for Construction helps Lake County homeowners plan cabinet work around kitchen layouts, storage, finishes and everyday use, including in Round Lake Heights.

 	Replace existing cabinets	Install cabinets as part of a broader kitchen remodel	Keep existing cabinets and update finishes or hardware
Best for	Replacing outdated cabinets while retaining the general kitchen layout	Coordinating cabinets with layout changes, finishes and other kitchen improvements	Keeping existing cabinet boxes when they suit household needs
What it addresses	Cabinet condition, storage and appearance	Cabinet planning alongside broader kitchen improvements	Cabinet appearance without replacing the full cabinet system
Disruption to the home	Work focused on cabinet replacement	Construction involving cabinet work and other planned kitchen changes	A narrower update than full cabinet replacement
Typical scope of work	Plan cabinet selection, finishes and fit within the existing layout	Organize layout direction, cabinet planning and finish selections before construction	Refresh cabinet finishes or hardware while retaining existing cabinets
When to consider	Existing cabinets no longer support daily use or desired storage	Cabinets are part of a kitchen layout or finish update	Existing cabinets remain useful and homeowners want a limited refresh
Planning for older Lake County kitchens

Many local homes built from the 1950s through the 1990s—including ranches, split-levels, and colonials—have kitchens shaped by the original floor plan. A replacement cabinet plan may need to account for soffits, uneven walls, older flooring, or appliance locations that limit standard cabinet sizes. Measuring the room carefully and checking what is behind the existing finishes helps set a realistic scope before installation begins.

Freeze-thaw winters are part of life in this region, but indoor cabinet performance is most directly affected by normal household conditions such as moisture, heat, and ventilation. We consider how cabinets meet the walls and floor, how doors and drawers will function in tight spaces, and whether the layout gives you practical access to dishes, cookware, and supplies. Homeowners in Round Lake Heights and Hainesville can request a free estimate to review their kitchen’s specific constraints and goals.

When replacement makes sense

Cabinet replacement may be worth considering when boxes are damaged, shelving no longer meets your needs, doors and drawers are difficult to use, or the current layout wastes available space. It can also be a sensible part of a kitchen update when the cabinets’ condition or style conflicts with other planned work. If the cabinet boxes are sound and the layout works, ask us whether a more limited update could meet your priorities; replacement is not automatically the right answer for every kitchen.

A cabinet project is also a chance to correct practical frustrations: too little drawer storage, hard-to-reach corner shelves, a crowded cooking area, or a pantry that does not hold everyday items well. Before choosing products, make a short list of what currently works and what does not. In Round Lake Park, as elsewhere in the service area, we can use that list to guide choices and explain how cabinet installation fits a larger renovation. See our general contractor services for related home improvement work.

Permits and project coordination

Permit needs depend on the work involved and the rules of the authority serving your property. A cabinet-only change may differ from a project that alters plumbing, electrical systems, walls, or the kitchen footprint. We review the scope and handle permit coordination when permits are required, so the right steps are part of planning rather than an afterthought. Local requirements can vary; the responsible village or county office determines applicable approvals.

Our permit resources explain what homeowners can expect, and you can consult the county’s building permit information as a starting point. If you are still defining the work, the scope builder can help organize project ideas before we discuss them.

Kitchen Cabinet Installation & Replacement Timeline

Every project is different. These ranges are planning estimates, not promises; the work involved and any permit-related considerations can affect the timeline.

Planning and selections
1–3 weeks

Discuss cabinet needs and layout direction, then organize cabinet planning, finish selections and budgeting before construction begins.

Prepare for construction
1–2 weeks

Confirm the project plan and coordinate any permit-related considerations that apply to the work.

Cabinet installation
1–2 weeks

Remove or prepare existing cabinetry as needed, then install the planned cabinets. The work involved can affect the time required.

Finishing and review
1–2 weeks

Complete remaining project details and review the installed cabinetry and finishes.

Our kitchen cabinet installation process

We make decisions in a clear order so selections, preparation, and installation support the same project plan.

01
1. Discuss your kitchen

We learn what is not working, what you want to keep, and whether you are considering cabinet replacement alone or a wider kitchen remodel.

02
2. Review the room and scope

We assess the existing layout, cabinet conditions, dimensions, and related work. This helps identify constraints such as appliance clearances, wall conditions, or changes that may require permit coordination.

03
3. Plan and select

We refine cabinet placement and storage needs, then review cabinet types, materials, door styles, finishes, and hardware. Other connected selections are considered alongside cabinetry.

04
4. Prepare and coordinate

Before installation, we confirm the agreed scope, organize the work sequence, and handle required permit coordination. The schedule and preparation details depend on the project.

05
5. Install and review

We install the cabinets and associated components included in the project, check door and drawer operation, and review the completed work with you.

Cabinet choices to consider

A few focused decisions can help make the new kitchen easier to use.

Storage that fits your routine

Plan everyday dishes, cookware, food, and small appliances before selecting drawers, shelves, pantry cabinets, or pull-outs.

A finish that works with the room

Compare painted and stained finishes with your planned counters, flooring, backsplash, and the natural light in the kitchen.

Scope that matches the home

Decide whether you need cabinet replacement alone or coordinated layout and finish updates as part of a larger renovation.

Our Story

See, touch, and feel the difference

As you enter our showroom, the difference our experience makes will inspire you. Stop in to be a part of  the beauty our displays have to offer. Our designs master the harmony of practical function and aesthetic design solutions while meeting the creative and technical needs of today's homes.

Service is the foundation of our business

From design ideas to analysis and integration of your selections, Completely Kitchens, LLC is the only place to go where our team of experts in their respective fields will complete your home just as you envisioned. Since 1985, it has been our pleasure to deliver the "wow factor" with great pride that shows. You will see it in the extras we deliver through skilled designers and installers that parallel the impressive quality of our design and cabinetry. We take the time to perfect even the smallest of details.

Navigating through the process

Designing the space of your dreams is easy at Completely Kitchens. Enjoy one-on-one consultation with a designer who will visit  your space where we will obtain measurements and appreciation for your lifestyle and design style. During this visit, we will learn what is important to you in order to create design solutions specific to your needs. There is only one place in Ames to find the custom and affordable cabinetry your home or workspace deserves. For floor to ceiling application and all points in between (painting, installation, plumbing, tiling, lighting, etc.), look to Completely Kitchens... we complete your home! 

Our Team

THE BEST AND BRIGHTEST

Russ Jones

Chief of Operations

Russ, a co-owner, has many years of experience with construction, remodels, and building. He is an expert at making a clients vision come to life. Russ handles all of the demo, installation, and details for our clients. 

Mikayla Cornwell 

Director of Communications

Mikayla runs our marketing and communications. With over 8 years in social media marketing, she utilizes those skills for our social media pages and website. 

Becky Jones

CEO

Becky, a co-owner, has over 2 decades of project management experience. She is adept at helping clients define and create their dream space. Becky also handles many of the details that come with day to day operations for Completely Kitchens. 

Levi Marcoux

Lead Designer

Levi is our extremely talented designer. He creates gorgeous designs bringing our clients’ vision to life. Levi is an Iowa State alumni and has over 4 years of design experience.

Desk creation and installation at Cultivating Hope Farms

We were honored to donate our time and materials to create and install this desk at Cultivating Hope Farms. A huge thank you to HeRo Creations for wrapping the desk legs in hickory and lending a hand with the install.

The quartz top is made by Silestone by Cosentino and is the design Pearl Jasmine Polished.

Cultivating Hope Farms is a local nonprofit farms that strives to create and unique and enriching environment for children with autism. They are expanding their indoor barn area and the desk is part of the new area.

JANUARY 18, 2024
Is a Kitchen Remodel Tax Deductible

A brand new kitchen definitely increases value in your home, but does it also decrease the amount of taxes you have to pay? 

The short answer is kind of. Some kitchen remodels can be tax deductible. But as we all know, taxes are not that straightforward - which also means our answer cannot be that straightforward. 

Kitchen remodels can only create tax deductions when you actually sell your home. It can be subtracted from capital gain, thus lowering the amount of capital gains tax you would have to pay. Capital gains tax only applies when you sell your house and you make more than $250,000 filing alone or $500,000 filing jointly (if you’ve owned your house for more than 2 years). Capital gains tax always applies if you’ve owned your house for less than 2 years

Let’s say you have lived in your home for one year and bought it for $100,000. You complete a kitchen remodel for $25,000 and turn around and sell your house for $225,000. The kitchen remodel of $25,000 is deducted from your capital gains - meaning you only have to pay taxes on $100,000 of the profit you make. 

But the chances of every kitchen remodel falling into the category of being tax deductible is very small. If you have lived in your house for more than 2 years and wouldn’t make more than $250,000 on the sale of your house - a remodel wouldn’t affect your taxes at all. 

As with all tax questions, make sure to ask a tax professional before making any decisions. We are a kitchen remodeling company, after all! Tune in next week to see our latest blog post - and reach out to us at showroom@completelykitchens.com if you have any questions!

pages.text:

NOVEMBER 9, 2023
How to Choose a Backsplash

So you’ve begun making some big decisions about your new kitchen. The color of the cabinets, the countertops, maybe the wall color. You feel like you’re in the home stretch - until you realize you still have to decide the backsplash! Picking out all of the details for your kitchen can definitely be challenging - but fear not, we are here to help! Join us as we break down how to choose a backsplash. 

What are the different backsplash types?

There are three main types of backsplashes: a traditional set-on backsplash, a tile backsplash, or a full height quartz backsplash.

Set on Backsplash

These are a very traditional style backsplash where (typically) a 4-inch portion of your countertop is set-on to the wall behind it. It prevents spills and messes from ending up entirely on your kitchen walls. As you can see in the picture below, this is a great way to finish your space. A 4-inch in backsplash is an extremely cost effective and traditional choice. 

Tile Backsplash

Tile backsplashes have an entire world of possibilities. Depending on the color, size, pattern, and type of tile you choose - it can entirely transform your space. Just think of the difference between a white subway tile backsplash and the blue hexagons in the photo. The choice of tile could make the kitchen a relaxing neutral palette or rejuvenate the space with a vibrant pop of color. Based on your tile choices and preferences, this type of backsplash can be an extremely reserved and classic backsplash or a modern and vibrant piece of art. Because of the differences in choices, tile could be your most expensive backsplash choice or a cost effective option. It depends on the style and vibe you are looking for within your kitchen. 

Full Height Quartz Backsplash

Full height quartz is a showstopper. This is a continuation of your countertops all the way to the bottom of your cabinets or your ceiling in one full slab. As you can imagine, this is a great way to make your kitchen elegant, refined, and memorable. Depending on how high your full height backsplashes go, this type has the potential of being high cost but it is a great way to create a unified and modern feel in your kitchen.

What is Best for You? 

Now that we understand the different types of backsplashes - how do we decide which style to choose? First, I want you to ask yourself a few questions. 

Are you a messy cook or do you have messy kids? A 4 inch backsplash only protects a small portion of your kitchen walls. Tile or full height quartz are definitely the first choices if you a backsplash you can easily wipe down with a washcloth and soap. 

Do you like to hang utensils, spices, or artwork on your kitchen walls? If you answered yes to this question, you will want to pick the 4-inch backsplash. It is much more challenging to hang artwork or utensils on tile or quartz walls, so that may make your decision much easier. 

What type of style are you leaning towards in your kitchen? Traditional kitchens typically have tile or 4-inch backsplashes while more modern or trendy kitchens can have either tile or full height quartz. Think about your cabinet choice, countertop color, and overall vibe of your kitchen to help you decide here. 

What does your backsplash budget look like? If you are trying to stick closely to a budget for this renovation project, a 4-inch backsplash or a cost effective tile will give you the finished look in your kitchen without derailing your budget entirely. 

Finally, which style do you prefer? This is your dream kitchen we are creating after all - and any of the above suggestions are only that, suggestions. Choose what fits your design to complete your home!

As always, if you have any questions; please reach out to the Completely Kitchens team either on our website or at showroom@completelykitchens.com. We look forward to working with you on your renovation projects and completing your home!

OCTOBER 17, 2023
A Showcase of Our Latest Bathroom Remodel

As you can imagine, every remodel project we tackle comes with its own unique challenges. Our most recent project is no different. We teamed up with one of the local college fraternities to create a bathroom that is elegant, durable, and functional. Join us as we overview the project, tackle unique challenges, and reveal the beautiful new space. 

Before

The main issues of the existing bathroom were the 30+ year old tiles on the walls and floor, the lack of sink space, and no existing shelving and towel hooks. Our designers and contractors joined up with the fraternity members to create a stunning bathroom design that tackled all of the existing issues. 

To prevent water damage in the shower room and overall bathroom, we knew we needed to waterproof the walls. But one of the main complaints about the original bathroom was how difficult it was to keep the tile clean and the grout white. We proposed skipping the tile entirely and instead covering the walls with quartz. Not only did this waterproof the walls, quartz is extremely durable and mildew resistant - not to mention stunning. 

To solve the lack of sink space, we changed the design of the original bathroom to have 4 countertop sinks instead of 3. We also added a countertop cutout for a trash can to cut down on clutter and create better flow in and out of the room. 

Finally to create more storage and functionality - we added shelves and towel hooks in the entry hallway. This gives the men somewhere to store their bathroom caddy while showering or a place to hang their towel while they brush their teeth.

Our Challenges

The first major challenge of this remodel project was removing thousands of 30+ year old one inch tiles. Each tile had to be removed piece by piece which took a lot of elbow grease!

The second major challenge was a looming deadline. Once summer classes came to a close and the fraternity was vacante for summer, we had only a few weeks to demo the entire existing bathroom, finish the electrical and plumbing, install the vanity and quartz walls, build and install shelves and towel hooks, paint, and reinstall bathroom and shower partitions. Thankfully with careful planning and a lot of long hours from our fantastic contractors we finished the project with an entire week to spare. Just in time for the students to return and begin the fall semester. 

Finished Project

And now the moment you’ve been waiting for. The final video walkthrough of the finished bathroom!

Embracing the Cozy: Fall 2023 Kitchen Design Trends

Fall is just around the corner, with fall leaves, warm ciders, cozy sweaters, and roaring fires. And with all that, it's the perfect time to warm up your kitchen space with a trendy remodel. This fall, kitchen design trends are all about creating inviting, and cozy yet functional spaces to make your kitchen come to life. Here’s 7 trends to watch out for this fall!

Rich, Earthy Tones

Say goodbye to bright and sterile kitchen colors. This fall, we're seeing a shift toward rich, earthy tones like warm terracotta, deep forest green, and muted coppers. These colors evoke a sense of comfort and coziness.

Open Shelving

Open shelving is still alive and well in kitchen design. It's perfect for displaying your favorite fall-themed décor, such as rustic pottery, copper cookware, or pumpkin scented candles.

Textured Backsplashes

Textured backsplashes are all about making a statement. Many designers are leaning towards hand cut tiles and rough raised edges to add personality to an otherwise flat backsplash. 

Warm Lighting

Soft, warm lighting fixtures, such as pendant lights with amber or frosted glass shades, create a cheery ambiance that’s perfect for hosting. 

Natural Materials

Sustainable and natural materials like bamboo, reclaimed wood, and stone are being incorporated into kitchen design to create eco-friendly and beautiful spaces.

Minimalist Design

Streamlined cabinetry, smart storage solutions, and clutter free counters are all the rage. Gone are the eclectic, cluttered knick knacks - clean and quiet decor items are taking their place. 

Statement Sinks

Unique sinks, such as farmhouse or hammered copper sinks, are becoming focal points in kitchen design, adding character and personality to your space. 

Fall 2023's kitchen design trends are all about creating a warm, inviting, and functional space that reflects your personal style. Whether you're planning a full-scale remodel or just looking to make some small updates, these trends can help you achieve the cozy kitchen of your dreams. For more help and inspiration - visit our showroom at 204 Airport Road in Ames!

7 Ways to Update Your Kitchen on a Budget

We would all love a kitchen straight out of the Homes and Gardens magazine, but when eggs are $6 a dozen that isn’t in the cards for everyone. Here at Completely Kitchens, we believe every person should have a kitchen they love. So here are 7 Ways to Update Your Kitchen on a Budget.

1. Add Under Cabinet Lighting

It’s amazing how big of a difference light alone can make in the function and feel of your kitchen. We offer an under-cabinet lighting installation that is finished in an afternoon, and you will be astounded at how different your space feels. 

2. Swap out the Backsplash

Changing out your backsplash can make both your cabinets and countertops feel refreshed immediately. This can be done with a coat of paint or brand new tile, but either way it makes a big impact!

3. Install a New Sink

A fresh, new sink can make a big difference in the function and feel of your kitchen. If you change to a workstation sink like the one pictured above - dishes might even be fun to do!

4. Add New Drawer Knobs or Pulls

Changing out the decorative hardware or knobs on your cabinet doors is a great way to modernize your home without the cost of brand new cabinets. Just keep in mind that the new knobs or pulls should have the same number of screw holes for easy installation. 

5. Paint Your Cabinets

Whether you decide to DIY your own cabinet paint job or hire it done - a fresh coat of paint makes your cabinets feel brand new without the price. If you choose the DIY route - keep in mind it can be tough to get a factory level paint finish on your own. So this is best for experienced DIYers or to hire done. 

6. Create a Beverage Bar

Turning a small space into a coffee station, bar cart, or another functional space is another great addition to any kitchen. This can be done by adding simply a bar cart, or installing a second sink next to your coffee machine for easy cleanup!

7. Install New Quartz Countertops

Our final budget-friendly idea is installing new countertops. Quartz countertops are an amazing way to elevate the feel of your kitchen or even change the entire mood of the space. 

No matter what your budget is - we can help you create a space that you love. To schedule a free walkthrough and consultation of your kitchen or bathroom project - contact us today at showroom@completelykitchens.com. For more information check out our website and don’t forget to tune in next week to our latest blog post!

AUGUST 10, 2023
Choose Your Countertop Type
Kitchen Remodel, Countertop Replacement

Have you been eyeing that same scratch in your laminate countertop for years? Do you have an old school tile countertop that you would like to drag out to the curb? Or maybe you want to refresh your kitchen without going through the trouble of an entire demo process? Well a Countertop Replacement could be the answer to all of your problems! Join us as we talk through a countertop replacement - the products, timeline, and process. 

Products

Choosing the type of countertop you want in a kitchen can seem like a huge decision. At Completley Kithchens we offer laminate, quartz, granite and Dekton countertops.

Laminate

Laminate countertops make up our most budget-friendly countertops. You can get many different colors and patterns in laminate, but the counter is composed of plastic fused to particle board. So in terms of durability, laminate comes in as the least durable type we offer. 

Granite

Granite counters are made of natural quartz stone and other feldspar. The different mineral compositions create its unique speckled patterns and different colors. Granite is scratch resistant but it is still a porous material. It has to be sealed with specialized granite sealant once a year, so it can become a hassle down the road. 

Quartz

Quartz is our most popular countertop type. It is extremely durable and strong, but unlike granite it does not need to be sealed every year. Quartz comes in a large variety of styles and colors - so you are sure to find a design you love. 

Quartz is stain resistant, scratch resistant, and an extremely durable surface to have in your kitchen. Stain resistant does not mean stain proof, so you need to wipe up spills like wine or grape juice immediately. Quartz is not heat resistant, so you cannot place a hot pan directly on the countertop with this material without the possibility of cracking.

Dekton

Dekton is a new product created by Cosentino. It is fusion of natural materials found in porcelain, quartz, and glass that are pressed together by an enormous amount of pressure. Using what is coined as “Sinterized Particle Technology,” Cosnetino has created one of the strongest countertop styles ever. If you take a look at the table below, you can see that not only does Dekton have all of the strength and durability of granite and quartz, it is also heat proof and virtually indestructible. 

Timeline

The timeline for all four of our countertop types are roughly the same. Once you have chosen your countertop type and design, in the next week we will be out to create a digital template of your countertop space so the stone or laminate is cut perfectly to size. From there it is about a 4-5 week lead time before your brand new countertops get installed. 

Process

The process for a countertop replacement is extremely straightforward. The first step is to select between laminate, granite, quartz and dekton. Then you will choose the design within your type of countertops; we have hundreds of sample pieces in our showroom for you to look through! After that, a 50% deposit is required for us to make the order and the digital template to be created. Your new countertop installation will be scheduled around 4-5 weeks out. A plumber will detach your kitchen sink and our Completely Kitchens Crew will demo your existing countertop typically the day before your new countertop install. After the new countertop is installed, the plumber will return to attach your new kitchen sink and faucet. The remaining payment is due at that time - and you are free to enjoy your beautiful new countertops!

If you are looking for a straightforward and budget friendly renovation that still has a big impact - look no further than countertop replacements! We talked through the products, timeline involved in a countertop replacement. If you are interested in having your countertop replaced - contact us at showroom@completelykitchens.com. And tune in next week to read our latest blog post for more information.

DAVID SHARBANI
2024 KITCHEN & BATH DESIGN NEWS INNOVATOR OF THE YEAR

Growing up in the construction business perfects client approach

David Sharbani started working for his father’s construction company when he was just a teenager, and has been in the design and remodeling industry for over 38 years. When he joined his father’s contracting business, his construction education and experience brought a new dimension to the company’s designs and remodels. How a project gets built became the forefront of every design. This angle helped clients attain their dream kitchen, bath, extension or home remodel.Specializing in kitchens and baths is particularly meaningful to him since his mother, born in France, instilled in him a love for fine design and family gatherings. Sharbani’s dad, Yeheskel, was an electrical engineer in a nuclear power plant before starting his construction business. Sharbani learned the art of precision and “do it right the first time” from his father, who insisted on this type of focus.  Today, Sharbani, who is president of Elite Kitchen & Bath in Manhasset, NY, leads a team that starts every project by asking clients how they use their space, and how they would like to use it after it is renovated. These simple questions lead the project design and remodel. His design approach stresses not only aesthetics, but functionality, longevity and ease of use.The firm’s work has been recognized with countless honors, including the Interior Design Society’s DOTY Award and the NARI Platinum & Gold Awards.https://www.kitchenbathdesign.com/david-sharbani/

Bath Brings the Gym’s Spa Experience Home - Kitchen & Bath Design News

Before

The homeowners, a professional couple, recently switched from working out at the gym to working out at home. However, they missed the refuge they found from their stressful day-to-day in the gym experience, including amenities such as a steam room, and wanted to replicate that in their home workout experience.  

After 

By extending the master bathroom into an underutilized second floor terrace, designer David Sharbani of Elite Kitchen & Bath in Manhasset, NY was able to enlarge the bathroom to almost twice its original size, creating enough space to produce the home spa of the clients’ dreams. Top of the clients’ wish list was a zero-clearance frameless recessed steam shower with a bench long enough to lay on, inspired by their love of the steam room at the gym. Hand-laid 4’x8′ shower tiles create the sleek minimalist look the clients craved, while a newly enlarged window bathes the space in natural light for a zen-like experience. Additional luxury touches include a bidet toilet seat, Italian high-gloss vanity and linen closet, heated floors and frameless mirrors.

Luxury Kitchen Remodeling on Long Island
What to Expect

Kitchens Designed for the Way You Live

A kitchen is more than a place to prepare meals. It is where families gather, conversations unfold, and everyday routines become meaningful moments.

At Elite Kitchen & Bath, we create luxury kitchens that combine exceptional design, premium materials, and expert craftsmanship. For more than 40 years, Long Island homeowners have trusted our team to transform outdated kitchens into sophisticated spaces tailored to their lifestyle.

As a full-service design-build firm, we manage every aspect of your renovation—from initial design concepts and material selections to construction and final installation—ensuring a seamless experience and exceptional results.

Schedule a Design Consultation

Long Island's Design-Build Kitchen Remodeling Experts

Unlike traditional remodeling projects that require homeowners to coordinate designers, contractors, and suppliers separately, our integrated design-build process brings everything together under one roof.

Our team handles:

Kitchen design and space planning

Custom and semi-custom cabinetry

Countertop selection

Appliance integration

Lighting design

Flooring and finish selections

Construction management

Project coordination and scheduling

The result is a more efficient process, greater accountability, and a beautifully executed kitchen that reflects your vision.

Luxury Kitchens Tailored to Your Home

Every home—and every homeowner—is different.

Whether you're seeking a contemporary kitchen with clean architectural lines, a timeless transitional design, or a warm traditional aesthetic, our designers create spaces that balance beauty and functionality.

Popular features include:

Large entertaining islands

Custom cabinetry and storage solutions

Integrated appliance designs

Walk-in pantries

Statement lighting

Quartzite, quartz, and premium stone countertops

Specialty coffee and beverage stations

Smart home technology integration

Our goal is to create a kitchen that not only looks extraordinary but also improves the way you live every day.

Our Kitchen Remodeling Process

Discovery Consultation

We begin by learning about your goals, lifestyle, aesthetic preferences, and investment expectations.

Design & Planning

Our design team develops detailed layouts, cabinetry plans, and finish selections that align with your vision.

Material Selection

Visit our showroom to explore cabinetry, countertops, fixtures, hardware, and design details with expert guidance.

Construction & Installation

Our experienced craftsmen execute every phase of the renovation with meticulous attention to detail.

Project Completion

Before completion, we conduct a comprehensive walkthrough to ensure every element meets our standards and exceeds your expectations.

Why Homeowners Choose Elite Kitchen & Bath

For over four decades, homeowners throughout Long Island have selected Elite Kitchen & Bath because of our:

Proven design-build process

Experienced design professionals

Premium cabinetry and material selections

Commitment to craftsmanship

Frequently Asked Questions

How long does a kitchen remodel take?

Project timelines vary based on scope, complexity, and material selections. Most complete kitchen renovations require several months from design through construction.

What does a kitchen remodel cost on Long Island?

Investment ranges vary significantly based on cabinetry, appliances, structural changes, and finish selections. During your consultation, we provide guidance based on your specific goals and priorities. Luxury kitchen gut remodels typically cost between $150k - $500k. Smaller luxury remodels will range from $75k-$100k. 

Do I need a designer and a contractor?

No. Our design-build process combines design, planning, and construction into one coordinated experience, eliminating the need to manage multiple firms.

Can I visit your showroom?

Yes. Our showroom allows homeowners to explore cabinetry, countertops, hardware, fixtures, and design options in person.

What Does a Luxury Kitchen Remodel Cost on Long Island?
Luxury Kitchens dominate Long Island's North Shore
Understanding the Investment Behind a Luxury Kitchen Renovation

One of the first questions homeowners ask when planning a kitchen renovation is:

"How much will my kitchen remodel cost?"

The answer depends on many factors, including the size of the space, the level of customization, structural changes, cabinetry selections, appliances, and finish materials.

While every project is unique, understanding the typical investment ranges can help you plan confidently and make informed decisions.

At Elite Kitchen & Bath, we have helped Long Island homeowners transform their kitchens for more than 40 years through our comprehensive design-build process. This guide explains the factors that influence cost and what you can expect when planning a luxury kitchen renovation.

Typical Kitchen Remodeling Investment Ranges on Long Island
Cosmetic Kitchen Update
$35,000 – $60,000+

Suitable for homeowners who wish to refresh an existing kitchen layout while updating finishes.

Typical improvements may include:

New countertops

New backsplash

Semi-Custom Cabinetry 

Updated lighting

New sink and faucet

Limited electrical and plumbing modifications

Best for kitchens where the existing layout functions well and major structural work is not required.

Full Kitchen Renovation
$75,000 – $150,000+

Many Long Island homeowners choose this level of renovation to improve functionality, increase storage, and modernize outdated spaces.

Typical scope may include:

Complete demolition

New cabinetry

Premium countertops

Updated flooring

New appliances

Lighting redesign

Electrical upgrades

Plumbing upgrades

Enhanced storage solution

Luxury Custom Kitchen Renovation
$150,000 – $300,000+

This category includes highly customized projects designed around the homeowner's lifestyle.

Features may include:

Custom luxury cabinetry

Large entertaining islands

Architectural millwork

Professional-grade built-in appliances

Walk-in pantries

Specialty storage systems

Smart home integration

Imported materials

Significant layout modifications

Home bar/Coffee bar 

These kitchens are often designed as the centerpiece of the home and reflect a highly personalized approach.

Estate-Level and Fully Customized Kitchens
$300,000+

These projects typically involve extensive design, engineering, and construction.

They may include:

Structural modifications

Wall removal

Home additions

Custom furniture-quality cabinetry

Integrated luxury appliance packages

Specialty stone fabrication

Extensive architectural detailing

These kitchens are tailored to the unique needs of the homeowner and often become showpiece spaces within the home.

What Has the Biggest Impact on Cost?

Understanding the major cost drivers can help homeowners prioritize their investment.

Cabinetry

Cabinetry is often the largest component of a kitchen renovation budget.

Options generally include:

Stock cabinetry

Semi-custom cabinetry

Fully custom cabinetry

Imported luxury cabinetry

Higher-end cabinetry offers greater customization, improved construction quality, enhanced finishes, and specialized storage solutions.

Countertops

Material selection significantly affects project cost.

Popular luxury options include:

Quartz

Quartzite

Marble

Porcelain

Exotic natural stone

Each material offers unique benefits related to appearance, durability, and maintenance requirements.

Appliances

Appliance selections can vary dramatically depending on brand and functionality.

Luxury kitchens often include:

Built-in refrigeration

Professional cooking appliances

Steam ovens

Wine refrigeration

Kitchen Remodeling FAQs
Kitchen Design, Remodel & Installation Questions
How do I start a kitchen remodel?

The first step in any kitchen remodeling project is preparation. Gather inspiration photos, any existing plans, and rough measurements of your current kitchen. Schedule a consultation with a professional kitchen designer.

During your initial kitchen design consultation, your designer will review your layout options, design style, color preferences, construction needs, timeline, and overall budget. Bringing photos of kitchens you love helps communicate your vision clearly.

Important: Always hire a fully licensed and insured kitchen contractor with both general liability insurance and workers’ compensation coverage. If a contractor is not properly insured, the homeowner may be financially liable for any job-site injuries.

What decisions are involved in a kitchen remodel?

A successful kitchen renovation requires several key decisions, including:

Keeping the existing kitchen layout or changing the footprint

Selecting and ordering kitchen appliances (required before final design approval)

Choosing cabinet brand, door style, drawer construction, materials, and finishes

Planning kitchen lighting and plumbing locations

Selecting cabinet storage solutions and organizers

Reviewing and approving final kitchen design drawings

Cabinetry cannot be ordered until all designs are finalized and approved.

Should I hire a full-service kitchen remodeling firm or separate contractors?

Hiring a full-service kitchen design and remodeling firm simplifies the entire process. A design/build firm manages kitchen design, cabinetry, construction, and installation from start to finish. They also coordinate countertops, backsplashes, appliances, flooring, plumbing, electrical work, windows, doors, and hardware.

If you hire a separate kitchen designer and contractor, the designer will create the layout and supply cabinetry, while the contractor handles construction. In this case, ensure the designer remains involved throughout the project to support quality control and execution.

Do I need a permit for my kitchen remodel?

Most kitchen remodels require permits, especially when plumbing, electrical, or structural work is involved. Work with a licensed kitchen remodeling contractor who understands local building codes and will obtain all required permits.

What is the kitchen design and installation process?

After your initial meeting, your kitchen designer will present a preliminary design and estimated budget. Once you decide to proceed, a design retainer is typically required and is often applied toward your cabinetry purchase.

Your designer will then take detailed measurements of your kitchen space. The design process continues until the final kitchen layout is approved. A 50% deposit is generally required to place the cabinet order.

If construction work is required, a contractor will evaluate your home and provide an estimate. A design/build firm manages all design, cabinetry, construction, and installation services under one roof.

When should I select my kitchen appliances?

Kitchen appliances must be selected before the design is finalized. Appliance sizes and configurations directly impact cabinetry and layout.

Decisions such as:

Professional range vs. cooktop and wall ovens

Refrigerator size (30”, 36”, 48” or custom columns)

Built-in vs. counter-depth refrigeration

Microwave drawers, steam ovens, wine or beverage units

Hood – Style, size,  vented out or not.

All influence the kitchen design and must be determined early.

What other kitchen selections will I need to make?

In addition to cabinetry and appliances, you’ll also choose:

Kitchen lighting fixtures

Plumbing fixtures

Flooring materials

Backsplash tile

Countertops

Paint colors

Cabinet hardware

Outlet color

Making selections early helps avoid delays, as many appliances and other materials have extended lead times.

Does the cabinet brand matter in a kitchen remodel?

Yes. Cabinet quality significantly affects durability, functionality, and long-term appearance. High-quality custom cabinetry offers superior construction, refined finishes, and longer warranties.

Cabinet options typically fall into three categories:

Luxury custom cabinets: Highest level of craftsmanship and finish

Semi-custom cabinets: Excellent quality with more budget flexibility

Stock cabinets: Best for lower budgets, with construction and finishes aligned with cost

Your kitchen designer can help you choose the best cabinetry for your budget and lifestyle.

How much does a kitchen remodel cost?

Kitchen remodel costs vary widely based on design choices and materials. Cabinetry typically ranges from $10,000 to $150,000, while appliance packages may range from $8,000 to $60,000 or more.

Cabinet quality should align with appliance investment and overall project goals. Labor complexity, materials, finishes, and construction scope all impact total cost. Discussing your budget early helps your designer create a well-balanced plan.

How long does a kitchen renovation take?

The kitchen remodeling timeline begins after final design approval and deposit. Typical lead times include:

Custom kitchen cabinets: 12–15 weeks

Semi-custom cabinets: 6–10 weeks

Stock cabinets: approximately 2 weeks

Construction may begin before cabinetry arrives and can take 1–8 weeks depending on the scope. Cabinet installation typically takes 1–2 weeks.

Can a kitchen designer work with my architect or interior designer?

Yes. Professional kitchen designers regularly collaborate with architects and interior designers. The kitchen designer adapts architectural plans to work seamlessly with cabinetry, appliances, and construction requirements, ensuring a cohesive final result.

Do contractors typically offer remodeling services beyond kitchens?

Yes. Many kitchen design showrooms operate as full-service design/build firms. Licensed contractors can also remodel bathrooms, renovate entire homes, and design and construct home additions.

Our Remodeling Services
Book Your Consultation

At Clar Construction, we are dedicated to transforming homes to fit the needs and desires of our clients. Located in Montpelier, VT, our team of skilled craftsmen brings a wealth of experience to every project. Whether you’re considering a kitchen update, a bathroom redesign, or expanding with an addition, our portfolio showcases our commitment to quality and precision. We don’t just undertake renovations; we create spaces tailored to the lifestyles of their inhabitants.

The remodeling process can seem complex, but with Clar Construction guiding you, it’s a collaborative effort. From the first consultation to the final walk-through, our focus is to bring your vision to life. We handle projects of all magnitudes, from minor adjustments to full-scale home renovations. Every service is aimed at enhancing the functionality, look, and value of your property. Choose Clar Construction for a remodeling journey that’s efficient, tailored, and distinctly Montpelier.

Every homeowner wants to have their kitchen function well to serve their cooking needs and for it be a beautiful and perhaps social space. At Clar Construction, our team will work in partnership with you to design and produce the kitchen of your dreams by listening and understanding your specifications and needs.

If you are interested in customizing your kitchen design to fit your taste, budget, and to make it as efficient and functional as possible, contact us today so we can talk more about your project. We look forward to speaking with you and helping craft the best kitchen possible.

Custom Kitchen Renovation for Style and Function

A well-planned Kitchen Renovation improves workflow, maximizes storage, and enhances the overall value of your home. Whether you prefer a modern, traditional, or transitional design, we tailor each renovation to match your taste and budget.

If you are ready to renovate your kitchen to make it more functional, organized, and visually appealing, contact Clar Construction today. Let’s discuss your goals and create a kitchen that truly fits your home.

 
Benefits of Remodeling Your Kitchen
Updated Look and Feel

For many families, the kitchen serves as the center of the home. Having a great-looking and functional kitchen to cook, entertain and relax in has never been more important. We will work with you to plan and design the kitchen of your dreams. Whether your home and personal aesthetic suggest modern, farmhouse, traditional or a combination of multiple styles, we have the expertise to help you bring your kitchen design to reality. Thoughtful design, new cabinetry and countertops, and efficient and effective lighting plans are just the start of the list of services we bring to our projects.

Improved Layout and Function

There are many ways to layout your new kitchen, though sometimes the space dictates what is most cost-effective. We specialize in kitchen remodeling and have helped clients with kitchens of all shapes and sizes to get the most out of their space. We plan out the entire project with you in advance before a single tool is lifted. With the right team in place you will be well on your way to getting the kitchen of your dreams for the next holiday or get together

Increased Storage Space

A key benefit and reason to undergo a kitchen remodel is the ability to add more storage. A modern kitchen often prioritizes finding ways to add additional cabinets, shelving units, and walk-in-pantries. We can help you plan and strategize the best organization methods for your kitchen needs – from how the appliances get distributed in the space to where the measuring cups get stored.

Personalized Design

Lastly, and most importantly, planning a kitchen remodel allows our team to help you bring your vision to life for all the design elements that matter to you most. If you have an outdated kitchen or you have simply changed your taste, being able to customize your kitchen to your personal taste and overall home aesthetic is very exciting and one of the greatest benefits to custom remodeling. We want to design and build you a kitchen you are going to love for many years to come, so working with you to get all the details right is of the utmost importance to us.

Planning Your Kitchen Remodel

The first step to take when planning your kitchen remodel is to evaluate your existing space and begin considering the features of the project that are most important to you.  Are you looking to simply make some aesthetic changes or are you looking for a complete renovation?  What is your overall budget?  What type of materials to select? 

We can help you answer these important questions and provide you with the guidance needed to make sure your project is successful.

Bathroom Remodeling

Updating your bathroom is generally on top of everyone’s list when it comes to finding ways to improve your home’s functionality and experience.  At Clar Construction, our team of professionals will help you with every aspect of your bathroom remodeling project, from concept through completion.

We help our clients by listening to their wants and needs to produce high-quality spaces tailored to their preferred taste and aesthetic.  Whether it is a half bath or a complete master bath remodel, we have the knowledge and expertise to bring your project to life. Contact us today to discuss your bathroom remodeling needs.

A well-planned Bathroom Renovation can significantly improve comfort, functionality, and long-term home value. If you are planning to renovate a bathroom, it is important to focus on layout efficiency, quality materials, and durable finishes that perform well over time. At Clar Construction, we guide homeowners through every stage of the renovation process, from design planning to final installation. Whether updating fixtures, improving storage, or completing a full master bath transformation, our team ensures each detail aligns with your goals. When you are ready to renovate a bathroom, we deliver practical solutions with skilled craftsmanship and clear project coordination.

Benefits of Bathroom Remodeling
A More Enjoyable & Modern Space

Bathrooms have moved beyond simply being a purely functional space. More and more homeowners are taking the opportunity to beautify the space in addition to improving the quality of the layout and existing fixtures.  A walk in shower, better lighting, glass shower doors, tiled floors and showers, an added window, and heated floors are just some of the things you can add to your improved bathroom.

Increased Storage Space

A key benefit and reason to undergo a bathroom remodel is the ability to include more storage. As larger bathrooms are becoming more and more desirable, homeowners are looking to incorporate more storage solutions. Solutions such as additional cabinets, shelving units and linen closets to help minimize clutter on countertops and in other areas of the bathroom. We can help you plan and strategize the best organization methods for your bathroom needs.

Improved Layout & Functionality

If you find yourself frustrated with the current layout and functionality of your current bathroom design, we feel your pain and are here to help. We will work with you to update the layout to your needs and specifications and make suggestions on how to get the best use of your bathroom space. Having a team of experts work with you to improve your space will allow you access to the solutions that we have found to work on the many bathrooms we have built.

Personalized Design

Lastly, and most importantly, embarking on a bathroom remodeling project allows our team to help you bring your vision to life in a customized and personal way. If you have an outdated bathroom that you adopted from the previous homeowner or you simply decided it’s time to update the space, being able to personalize your bathroom to your aesthetic and overall design motif is very exciting and one of the greatest benefits to remodeling.

Planning Your Bathroom Remodel

We can help you answer these important questions and provide you with the guidance needed to make sure your project is successful.

Home Additions

Adding on to your existing home is a great way to transform your home’s functionality and the way you experience it. We pride ourselves in being able to help you create new spaces that seamlessly transition into your existing home.

Below we highlight ideas for how best to utilize the space provided by your new home addition and the many benefits that come with expanding your home’s square footage. Give us a call or send us an email, and we will schedule a time to talk in greater detail about your specifications and needs.

We have many ideas on how to help you get the most from your existing home. If you love your current home, stay there and let us help you find ways to design and build new spaces to fit your growing needs. Contact us today to discuss your home addition needs.  We provide reliable quotes, quality craftsmanship, and our team will respect your time and treat your space as if it was our own.

Whole-Home Remodeling

Sometimes our clients find just the right location for their new home, but the house itself is just a bit too dated or deteriorated to provide a new owner with the quality of life they are looking for. In these instances, a whole-home remodel should be considered. Our team can revise the floor plan, add windows to capture light and views, and install all the finishes to make your new house the home you want it to be.

Benefits of Whole-Home Remodeling
Improved Layout & Function

Many older homes had a floor plan that is inconsistent with how most of us want our homes to be laid out. We can move interior and exterior walls to open up the floor plan for a more spacious layout, or cut in new windows and doors to improve the connection from the indoors to the outdoors.

Often a whole home remodel will include a new kitchen, deck, mudroom or bedroom/bathroom plan. Our Planning Process is a helpful tool to make sure you’re getting the most out of your investment and that we are able to achieve the goals of the project.

Improved Energy Efficiency

A whole-home remodel is the perfect time to assess the energy efficiency of your home.  With walls opened up and exterior details installed, we can add interior or exterior insulation to minimize your operating expenses and carbon footprint.  To these ends, we’ll discuss insulation, ventilation, heating systems, photovoltaics, and other fuel sources to develop a package that makes the most sense for your home and you.

Planning Your Whole-Home Remodel

First step to take when planning your whole-home remodel is to evaluate your existing space and begin considering the features that will be most important to you.  Are you looking to simply make some aesthetic and fixture changes or are you looking for a complete renovation of multiple rooms and spaces?  What is your overall budget?  What type of materials to select?

We can help you answer these important questions and provide you with the guidance needed to make sure your project is successful.

Floorplan/layout for your lifestyle
Who does the home need to accommodate
Consider an accessory apartment for additional income
Energy efficiency

Contact Us Today
Upgrade Your Home's Exterior Living Space!

Many homes will benefit from a well-designed deck or porch. Our clients tend to appreciate the useful qualities of these spaces as they enjoy the outdoors that we appreciate in Vermont. By investing in a deck, porch, patio, pergola, fire pit, or an outdoor kitchen, you are promoting spending more time outdoors, all the while increasing the value of your home. 

Whatever the reason for wanting more outdoor living space for your home, Clar Construction is here to help make your project a reality. We have worked with many clients across the Montpelier region to help them with their deck, porch, and patio projects, and we hope we can do that for you, too. Contact us today to discuss your project in more detail.

Clar Construction Offers:

Deck building
Deck replacement
Porches
Patios
Outdoor kitchens
Pergolas
Hot-tub decks
Outdoor living and entertainment spaces
Outdoor Living Project Ideas
Garden or Storage Sheds
Covered Outdoor Kitchens or Grilling Stations
Screened-In Porches
Garden Arbors
Open-Air or Covered Pergolas
Gas Powered Stone Fire Pits
Covered Patios

Backyard Entertainment Space
Outdoor Lighting Packages
Benefits of Adding Outdoor Living Spaces
Enhanced Entertainment Options

When it’s nice outside there are few things that are more enjoyable then being able to spend time outdoors, relaxing and entertaining in the comfort of your own backyard. Make your home the go to place for your friends and family by enhancing your outdoor living spaces. Adding a larger deck, a covered patio, built-in firepit or pergola will make your home more enjoyable and provide more options for entertaining.

Adds an Extension to Your Home

People sometimes think of outdoor living spaces as being separate from their interior living space. At Clar Construction, we like to think of them as an extension of your home and we take the time and effort to help you design and plan decks, porches, patios and more that will give you the ability to have more space to enjoy. Let’s get creative by adding a functional outdoor kitchen, a patio roof, screened in porch, firepit or built-in storage.

Increases the Value of Your Home

By working with a company like Clar Construction, you will be getting quality craftsmanship and design to any project we work on together. Outdoor living enhancements, especially when done right, bring a wide range of value added options, including increasing the value of your home. If you ever decided to sell in the future, there is no doubt your outdoor living space would be a major selling point for your property.

Promotes Spending Time Outdoors

In today’s busy, work-filled world, we all need to take more time to relax and enjoy what nature has to offer. By investing in your home own outdoor living space your escape to nature is right outside your door.
There are many benefits to spending time outdoors, including stress-relief, mood enhancement, increases daily movement and so much more. If you have been thinking about upgrading your home’s backyard, give us a call to discuss your project today.

Planning Your Outdoor Living Project

First step to take when planning your outdoor living project is to evaluate your existing space and begin considering the features of the project that are most important to you.  Are you looking to simply looking to replace part of your existing deck? Or are you looking for something more ambitious, like a two-story deck and patio or wrap around front porch?  What is your overall budget?  What type of materials are you looking to select? 

We can help you answer these important questions and provide you with the guidance needed to make sure your project is successful. 

Features to Consider When Planning Your Outdoor Living Project
Who will be using the space most frequently
The flow of guests from the indoor to the outdoor space
Outdoor lighting options
What type of entertaining will you doing most
Seating for all of your guests
Do you have pets? How will they interact with the space?

We Provide Custom Woodworking Services

Our craftsman can build the details that will be just right for your project. In our 2,000 square foot shop, we build kitchen and bathroom cabinets, bookcases, closet, and other storage built-ins, mudroom built-ins, and custom trim details when projects require them. We also provide these services for homeowners and other contractors.

Custom Cabinetry & Built-Ins

We can build just about anything in the shop. Common projects that we have under construction on most days include:

Kitchen Cabinets
Bookshelves 
Bathroom Vanities with matching mirrors 
Mudroom Storage Solutions
Cubbies

Improving the lives of our clients and team through a commitment to quality craftsmanship and investment in our community.

About Clar Construction

Since 2004, Clar Construction has established itself as a leader in crafting bespoke living spaces. We have expertly remodeled homes, crafted custom additions, decks, cabinetry, and built-ins, ensuring every detail reflects our commitment to excellence. Our dedicated team, which includes skilled production staff, esteemed partners, reliable vendors, and our meticulous administrative professionals, stands ready to elevate your home to new heights.

Our approach sets us apart. We believe in transparency and meticulous planning. From the conceptualization phase, we work hand in hand with our clients, ensuring that every detail is outlined and understood. This collaborative method ensures clarity on costs and overall project expectations from the outset, guaranteeing a harmonious journey towards realizing your home’s potential.

Our Shop & Office Located Downtown Montpelier

Our headquarters is nestled within the historic National Clothespin Company building on Granite Street in Montpelier. Before we took residence, the company had processed its final 10,000 board feet of maple on machinery once used to craft the iconic spring-loaded clothespin — a hallmark Vermont invention from 1853.

In the time since the National Clothespin Company’s departure, we have been meticulously transforming this once-traditional woodworking establishment into a state-of-the-art millwork facility. We are immensely proud to carry on the tradition of crafting wood-based materials, now for our home remodeling clients, in this very space where wooden clothespins were once manufactured. The space itself is luminous, with abundant natural light, and it’s steeped in a century’s worth of industrial heritage — evident in its walls and floors.

Clar Construction named on the Top 500 Remodeler List by Qualified Remodeler.
- Our Core Values -
Quality Work

We take pride in our standards and a durable final product

At Clar Construction we: 

Use our knowledge of the whole house as a system
Plan carefully and invest time in quality
Are persistent at solving problems
Take pride in accuracy and efficiency
Choose quality materials
Produce excellent work we are proud to contribute to the community
Clear Communication
We value inclusive, two-way communication

At Clar Construction we: 

Seek mutual understanding of common goals
Work together to find solutions
Ensure everyone’s perspectives are understood
Ask questions, offer perspectives, and check-in regularly
Are sincere, honest, and genuine
Practice patience
Use a respectful tone with each other, with clients, vendors, and with trade partners
Respect & Trust
Sincere relationships define us

At Clar Construction we: 

Respect each other and all clients and partners
Anticipate one another’s needs and show up for each other
Keep our word
Follow through
Own up to mistakes
Acknowledge, respect, and respond to unexpected client needs
Work with trade partners whose standards and values align with ours
Acknowledge that we guests in our clients’ homes
Community
We are committed to our community and long term sustainability

At Clar Construction we:

Respond to people in need
Are generous

Constant Improvement
Our team is committed to learning, personal growth, self-fulfillment, and meaning in our work

At Clar Construction we: 

Pursue personal and professional growth
Are open to new ideas
It is safe to make mistakes and keep learning
Client feedback leads to action
Our Team
Dan Clar
Owner

Dan grew up in Rochester, NY and graduated college with a degree in Education.  While in College he started working for a contractor specializing in church steeple restoration and building where he spent half of his time in the millwork shop fabricating parts, and the other half dangling 125 feet up from a bowsons chair installing those parts.  It was that job that cemented his interest in working with his hands in the trades and was all he could do to complete college when his interests clearly revolved around carpentry and woodwork.  

In 2004 he started Clar Construction as its sole employee and has been dedicated to the success and growth of the business ever since.  

Dan lives in Montpelier.  In his free time he enjoys spending time with his wife and children, hiking Vermont’s mountains, getting out on the water, and is currently trying to figure out how to build a wooden canoe. 

 
Dana Hock
Controller

Dana grew up in Edinboro, PA and was recruited to play college basketball at UNC Asheville. She transferred to Edinboro University for her final years of college and graduated with a degree in Accounting.

After school Dana would spend the next 14 years working in the insurance industry moving through the ranks from an account management trainee, business analyst, to ultimately having her own fully staffed agency for 5 years.

When deciding where to open her agency she looked around at various locales and decided on Montpelier as it offers so many of the things that Dana appreciates – the 4 seasons, no billboards to be seen, the mountains, farms, all while being a very dog friendly community.

In 2018 after her career in insurance and her kids had gotten to a certain age, she joined Clar Construction, where she is our Financial Controller.
Dana lives with her husband, two children, and dog. In her freetime she enjoys coaching basketball and soccer, and reading.

Jared Coyne
Project Manager

Jared grew up in Boston, MA. After high school he went to UVM to study Environmental Education and then pursued trail building through AmeriCorps and the Appalachian Mountain Club. It was while building bridges and boardwalks in northern Maine that he decided to make a career out of woodworking.

After many years of seasonal work he began working with Clar Construction in 2018 as an Apprentice Carpenter. Eager to learn and naturally talented Jared ascended through the levels and as of 2023 he is one of our Lead Carpenters.

Jared lives in Duxbury with his wife and dog. In his spare time he enjoys hiking, snowboarding, biking and of course, renovating his own house.

Sherman Plumley
Lead Carpenter

Sherman grew up in the greater Burlington area, completing his high school years in the Youth Build program which set him up for the career in the building trades that he has been dedicated to since then.

After some years working in various welding fabrication, landscaping, and HVAC install positions he landed at Recycle North where he would spend the next 10 years moving through the ranks to become a Manager. In this position he directed crews to deconstruct buildings such that they could be recycled and re-used as much as possible. Sherman has a remarkable passion for the responsible and sustainable use of resources and even went on to teach a deconstruction class at Yestermorrow.

From there he went on to work for a Chittenden County residential remodeling company where he continued to hone his craft, now with an emphasis on building and remodeling. That position set him up well to join us here at Clar Construction as a Carpenter in early 2023.

Sherman lives with his wife and two children in Barre. In his free time he enjoys archery, playing Magic, and working on his house.

Bear Borges
Lead Carpenter

Bear began his career in 2011 and joined Clar Construction in 2025 as a high-level Carpenter, quickly advancing to our Lead Carpenter role. He enjoys working with clients, enhancing, restoring, and contributing to the enduring quality of their homes.

He appreciates the variety that his job provides as he works to solve the unique problems that emerge from one project to the next. “I take a lot of pride in what I do. Clar is a great team of people to work with. I would trust anyone on the team 100% with a project in my own home. It’s great to be a part of a team that has a reputation for quality work and service.”

Bear lives in Plainfield and enjoys playing guitar, gardening, and taking care of his kiddo.

Silas Mader
Carpenter

Silas grew up in Connecticut spending a lot of time in his dad’s woodworking shop and out on various job sites. He moved to Vermont to get a degree in outdoor education at Johnson State College, and then started working in property management.

Silas came to Clar Construction in 2024 as an apprentice carpenter. He wanted to work with his hands while having a sense of pride in his work. He lives in Montpelier with his partner and in his free time he enjoys crafting, gardening, and enjoying all of the outdoor recreation that Vermont has to offer.

ELSA
Apprentice Carpenter

Elsa grew up in Central Vermont, and after several years working in other fields, she decided to pursue her interest in carpentry when she joined Clar in 2025 as an Apprentice Carpenter. She likes working with a great team of people and the opportunity to constantly be learning. She also appreciates spending her days building tangible things and feeling “proud of what I accomplished at the end of the day.” After spending many years living elsewhere, Elsa now loves living and working in Central Vermont and is committed to her community. Outside of work, she enjoys spending time with friends, being outdoors, and being active in her community.

Robert Ryan
Apprentice Carpenter

Rob lives in Washington and joined Clar Construction in early 2026. He has quickly developed into a strong, contributing member of the team. Rob enjoys working with his hands to make our customers happy. He enjoys seeing the project evolve and the tangibility of the final product that results from his and the teams’ work. It is rewarding to see what a space is capable of becoming in the end. A family man through and through, he appreciates conversations that keep people on the same page, and he enjoys getting to know our clients. In his free time, he enjoys hiking, fishing, hunting, driving his side by side, and splitting wood for the family.
