Step 1: Get To Know Each Other

Whether our prospective clients call, email, or walk in the office, there is always a conversation where we will start to learn about each other. We find that people considering a project for their home sometimes have very distinct ideas about what they’d like to do, while others have a sense that they need something about their home to change to better satisfy their lifestyle. 

We’ll ask the questions that will allow you to share whatever your current thinking is. We’ll also likely suggest some other ideas that you may want to consider.

UNDERSTANDING OUR PROCESS

During this meeting, we will share with you the general outline of our process and determine if this Design-Build is a method you are comfortable with.

BUDGET DISCUSSION

We’ll also want to talk about the amount of money you’re considering investing in your home and how that amount relates to the price of similar projects we’ve already completed. We’ll suggest a range of costs during this initial consultation, or if the project has some complexity to it, we’ll set another meeting within a week to review what we think this price range will be.

ALIGNING OUR GOALS

If that price range is not consistent with your expectations, we’ll talk about ways to alter the scope to meet the budget goals. Or perhaps we’ll agree that we’re not a good fit for each other. That’s ok- It doesn’t always work! If we do agree that the budgeting goals are consistent with what we believe the price of the project will likely be, then we’ll ask you to enter into our Project Development Agreement.

Step 2: Project Development Agreement

The objective of the Project Development phase is to produce a project scope that meets the goals of the project.

DESIGN & PLANNING MEETINGS

Now that we’ve committed to working together within a target budget, we begin a series of meetings in which we will identify the scope of the project. Certain types of projects will engage one of the designers or architects we work with, while other types of projects will be designed with our in house staff.

It is through a series of meetings that we collaboratively establish exactly what it is that will be built for you– from the floor plan right down to the grout color and towel bars.

This is the way we know to make sure that everything will be accounted for both from the perspective of the user (there needs to be a place to hang the towel!) but equally important is that it is only when we identify all of these details that we can confidently provide the fixed price model that we work within.

During this process, we engage our trade partners and vendors to provide their expertise as we work to establish the scope and product selections. We’ll also talk about specific needs that may be uniquely important to your family and you – things like dust control, snow clearing, and accommodations that may need to be made for children or pets. You, of course, can decide to alter the goals of the project along the way – we’ll be clear to discuss the financial implications.

When we reach the end of the Project Development phase and see that everyone’s goals are in alignment, the next step is to commit to the construction agreement.

Step 3: The Construction Phase

CONSTRUCTION BEGINS

This is the step we have been working toward since the start of the project planning! One of our lead carpenters (who you will have already met) will be assigned to your project, and he or she will be your point person during construction. 

Our in house team of carpentry staff works in conjunction with a team of subcontractors that fulfill the specialty/licensed trades (electrical, plumbing, roofing, etc.).

COORDINATING OUR SCHEDULES

Everyone who is part of your project will be properly insured. We will progress through the various stages of your project with the lead carpenter orchestrating the schedule. You will receive periodic updates on what to expect for progress over the upcoming weeks and which trades will be working on your home.

All of the planning that we collaborated on pays off during the construction phase, minimizing questions (though there will still be some!) and supporting smooth progress and quality craftsmanship during the project.

Step 4: Project Completion & Warranty

FINALIZING YOUR PROJECT

Our clients are typically pretty excited to see us arrive at their home to start building their project. And we know that they’re similarly excited to see us go so they can begin enjoying their newly remodeled home. We’ll do everything we can to be as efficient with our scheduling as possible so you can start living in your space again without us as your daily guest! 

After all, this is the reason we’ve previously spent so much time regarding the upfront planning of the project during the PDA phase — it allows us to return your home to you in its new condition as quickly as possible.

We have the end of your project in our view from the day we begin it. As we approach the end of your project, we will schedule a time to meet with you to discuss any outstanding items that need to be completed to ensure that everyone experiences the project as a success. 

We’ll have our list of things to do, and you’ll have the opportunity to bring ideas to our attention that might be on your list. This way, we can address these items, while all of our resources are still at your home.

SERVICES

From a room remodel to a room addition -- planning to completion, we can make your project hassle-free with our own expert staff.

DESIGN

We look at each project as an empty canvas.  Your needs define space design. Our design professionals help you determine function and storage requirements -- colors and style -- necessities and wish lists. Then they go to work, creating a plan based on those needs, and your budget.

SELECTION

You will be able to select your cabinetry, counter tops, appliances and accessory options in our showroom.

EXPERIENCE

Our family has been providing our client families with custom design living spaces since 1946. Experience -- it is the most important thing we have to offer.

OUR WORK

DREAMING OF A NEW KITCHEN?

Dream no more! Complete renovations or new cabinets, large projects or small, we've helped so many people create the kitchen they've always wanted. Stop by our showroom. Let's get your kitchen design started. Modern Kitchen is here to help you redesign, remodel and relax.

TESTIMONIALS

Scroll through and read what our customers say about the Modern Kitchen experience.

Totally Pleased

"Modern Kitchen gave us the open concept kitchen we wanted—more counter space and additional seating. At Thanksgiving, honestly, we had 23 people here for dinner and it worked perfectly. We are totally pleased with Modern Kitchen. In fact after the kitchen, they remodeled our master bath, which we love. Next on the list is the guest bath. Our thanks to you, Mark, and your crew!"

 
Wow

"WOW - that's what we say to each other each day. We never thought we would have such a nice kitchen in this house. You guys were wonderful to work with and I especially appreciate the great communication. You always kept us informed of what was coming up and when there were changes and that was important to me. We are really, really happy that we went with Modern Kitchen and when the time comes to do our bathroom, there is only one business we will consider for the job. Thank you!"

 
Bathroom Of My Dreams

"I've always wanted a claw foot tub, modern kitchen fulfilled my wish list and gave me the bathroom of my dreams. I have complete confidence in Mark and Bunny to remodel my kitchen when the time comes."

 
No Surprises

"Mark is a hands on guy, a problem solver, there were no surprises and we're right on budget."

 
Someone To Do It All

"We are not do it yourselfers...we wanted someone to do it all and be responsible for it all."

 
Satisfied Customer

"I'm an interior designer so I basically knew what I wanted, and working with Dennis, I got it. Modern Kitchen has remodeled my last three kitchens....I guess you can say I'm a satisfied customer."

HOME PRODUCTS SERVICES OUR WORK ABOUT CONTACT
ABOUT

SERVICING SINCE 1946! 

Starting out, my grandpa Lance made cabinets by hand in his garage. The tradition continued in 1964 when my dad Steve joined him and I did so in 1986.

A lot has changed since our beginning, one thing hasn’t. Grandpa’s philosophy to be honest and give exceptional customer service. That is our commitment to you and your project.

We are three generation proud to have served so many of you and your remodeling needs.

We are here to help you Redesign, Remodel and Relax. 

— Mark Jones

OUR MISSION

Our mission is to provide exceptional kitchen and bath design services and products to builders, remodelers, and homeowners.

We do it by...

creating a team with the same work ethic established by our founder and continues with our management who live by the moral standard of care, respect, a positive attitude, and pride in our work.

being thoroughly professional

knowing our business and our customer's requirements knowledge and attention to detail are keys to our success.

skillfully integrating our designs and products to best meet the need of each customer we serve - sound advice and reliable products are the foundation of our company.

IN THE COMMUNITY

Indiana State Representatives Doug Miller, District 48 and Dale Devon, District 5 present Mark Jones with greetings and congratulations from Governor Eric Holcomb as Modern Kitchen celebrates their 75th anniversary.

We help Rochester and surrounding area homeowners bring their vision to life with honest pricing, clear communication, and high-quality craftsmanship.

Built with skill and attention to detail.

We treat your home like our own.

REAL HOMES. REAL TRANSFORMATIONS.

OUTDATED KITCHEN TO OPEN-CONCEPT MODERN SPACE

VIEW ALL PROJECTS

OUR SERVICES

Kitchen Remodeling

Bathroom Remodeling

Basement Remodeling

Exterior Renovations (Windows, Doors, etc.)

Decks, Enclosed Porches, etc.

From small updates to full transformations, we handle it all.

A LOCAL, FAMILY-OWNED BUSINESS YOU CAN TRUST

At Goldsmith Remodel and Design we’re a local family business that cares about doing things the right way.

We started this company to give homeowners a better remodeling experience - one built on honesty, communication, and quality work.

When you work with us, you’re working directly with the people responsible for your project - from the first meeting to the final walkthrough.

SIMPLE, STRESS-FREE PROCESS

1

FREE CONSULTATION

Tell us about your vision and goals. 

2

IN HOME VISIT & MEASUREMENTS

We take measurements and discuss details. 

3

DETAILED ESTIMATE

Know exactly what your project will cost.

4

BUILD & ONGOING COMMUNICATION

We keep you informed every step of the way.

5

FINAL WALKTHROUGH

We ensure every detail is perfect before completion.

“What an absolute pleasure it is to work with Goldsmith Remodel and Design. We have used them for multiple projects, most recently- they took on the large task of finishing our empty basement.

From beginning to end, Joe is the most professional contractor we've ever met. He is organized and has fantastic communication skills. The team left our house clean every day! He has the vision and experience to turn a half-framed unusable space into what is now our dream basement- adding on 2 large bedrooms, a luxury bathroom, multiple closets with cabinetry, the ultimate laundry room, spacious family room with accent wall, and a play room/office space for our growing family. All in a timely manner. Joe just 'gets it'!!

The quality of work and care put into every detail shows. There is no comparison in the quality of work the Goldsmith team completes- flooring, trim, tile work, painting, shelving, etc. all turned out FANTASTIC. We are amazed and will appreciate this beautiful space for years to come.

We 1000/10 recommend this company and look forward to working with them again in the future.”

-Nicole H., Rochester

WHAT OUR CLIENTS SAY

“We are very happy with the work Joe Goldsmith Remodeling did on our kitchen and master bathroom! From start to finish, Joe and his team were great to work with. They were friendly, professional and showed genuine care about getting the job done right. Joe helped us review our original rooms and listened to our ideas for changes. Thoughtful design, Quality craftsmanship, A process built around you.

We offer a full range of services to improve the look, function, and value of your home.

REAL WORK. REAL RESULTS

All photos on this website are real jobs completed by our team.

REMODELING DOESN’T HAVE TO FEEL OVERWHELMING

We take the time to understand your vision, budget, and goals from the very beginning. Our process is designed to keep everything clear, organized, and moving smoothly - so you always know what to expect.

Whether you’re remodeling one room or transforming your entire home, we’re here to help create a space you’ll love for years to come.

OUR PROCESS

REACH OUT

Fill out our CONTACT form and we’ll reach out by phone or email to learn more about your project and answer any questions.

IN-HOME CONSULTATION

We’ll schedule a visit to your home to go over ideas, take measurements, and get a clear understanding of your space and goals.

DESIGN & ESTIMATE

We create a detailed quote and, upon request, complimentary 3D rendering so you can visualize your new space before construction begins.

SELECTIONS & PLANNING

Once you have accepted the quote, we’ll guide you through selecting materials, finishes, fixtures, and more - whether you’re shopping for high-end or keeping things budget friendly. We create a “shopping guide” to help you know what you need to do. Once all materials are in - demo day begins!

DEMO & CONSTRUCTION

Our crew arrives ready to work while keeping the job site as clean and organized throughout the project. We’ll stay in communication every step of the way so you’re never left wondering what’s happening.

FINAL WALKTHROUGH

Once everything is complete, we walk through the project with you to ensure every detail meets expectations and you’re loving your new space.

We require a down payment when accepting our estimate & contract and at different stages of the project.

Process

From concept to completion, we will provide you with the home improvement guidance needed to navigate your way through the design/ build process.

01
Initial Consultation & Assessment
Book a phone, virtual, or in-home consultation using the button below and choose your preferred meeting type and time
At this meeting, we will determine the feasibility of your project
schedule consultation
02
Design
2-4 months
We will develop three types of plans for your project with lite, medium, and heavy designs reflecting different price ranges
We will review floor plans and renderings of the designs
We will go through a 3D virtual walk-through to help you get a sense of the space
03
Contract Development
Project site walk-through with our trade contractors
Exact costs are developed, options are chosen by client, and contract is developed
Our projects stay on budget with less than a 3% variance on average
04
Construction
2-5 months, depending on project
Pre-construction meeting is scheduled with your Sicora interior designer and project manager
As a client, you are given access to our app to track project progress and see updates or changes
A detailed punch list and walkthrough is scheduled before project completion
05
Warranty
A 2-year mechanical and 10-year structural warranty are provided
A walkthrough is scheduled 11 months after your project is completed for any repairs needed
If there are any issues with your project beyond these warranties, let us know. We want you to be completely satisfied and become clients for life
Ready to take the next step?

About

Welcome to Sicora! We’re a full-service design/build firm in the Minneapolis, Minnesota area. Founded in 2000 by Thomas Sicora, our firm specializes in providing timeless, customized design solutions for your home renovation project. We believe every home should function at its highest potential, and it’s our mission to find design solutions that allow you to fall in love with your home for the first time... or all over again. From concept to completion, you will find our design process engaging and transparent, and our product beautiful and cost effective. We call this the “Sicora difference.”

Serving Minneapolis and Beyond

We serve the communities of St. Louis Park, Edina, Minneapolis, Minnetonka, Golden Valley, Wayzata, Hopkins, Eden Prairie, Bloomington, Maple Grove, Excelsior, Deephaven, Woodland, Shorewood, and other communities in the Lake Minnetonka area.

EXPERT TIPS
What Are the Advantages of Working with a Design-Build Company?

What Are the Advantages of Working with a Design-Build Company?

Short answer: A design-build company puts design and construction under one roof, which means one team, one point of accountability, and a design fee that goes toward your project instead of disappearing into hourly billing. The result is tighter budget control, more streamlined communication, and a finished space that reflects one cohesive vision from the first sketch to the final walkthrough.

Here's what that actually looks like in practice.

Your Design Fee Goes Toward Your Project, Not Just Toward Planning

With many traditional remodeling paths, you pay an architect or designer by the hour, then separately hire a contractor to build what they drew — two fees, two relationships, and no guarantee the your budget number makes it to contract.

At Sicora, our design fee is applied to the cost of your project, rather than functioning as a stand-alone expense on top of construction. You're not paying twice to get from idea to finished space — you're investing in a design that's already working toward the cost of your build.

Budget Control Is Tighter

Separating design from construction creates a natural gap: a design gets finalized, then goes out to bid, and only then do you learn whether it's actually affordable to build. With design-build, budget is part of the conversation from day one. Design and construction costs are considered together throughout, which is a large part of why Sicora projects average staying within 3% of the budget — well ahead of the industry standard of 15–20%.

Communication Stays Streamlined

When the same company handles design and construction, there's no relay race between an architect, a separate contractor, and you standing in the middle translating between them. Your designer and your build team are already talking to each other, because they work for the same company and the same project. Fewer parties means fewer chances for a detail to get lost in translation.

Accountability Is Clear

When design and construction are handled by separate companies, a problem during the build can turn into a debate over whose fault it is — was it a design flaw or a construction issue? With one company handling both, there's no one else to point to. That single point of accountability tends to mean fewer disputes and faster resolutions when something needs adjusting.

One Vision, Carried Through to the End

A designer who hands off a set of drawings to a stranger has no real stake in how those drawings get executed. With design-build, the same designer who shaped your concept stays involved through construction — which means the vision that got you excited on paper is the same one project managers and trade partners are building toward on site.

Feasibility Built on Experience with Older Homes

Not every remodeling company works exclusively with older housing stock. Sicora does. Focusing on remodels of existing, established homes means we've encountered nearly every quirk that comes with older construction — and we know what to look for before it becomes a problem.

It's the kind of experience you can't see coming from a set of drawings alone — but it's exactly the kind of thing our team has learned to anticipate, plan around, and price for, instead of letting it stall a project mid-construction.

That experience shapes design decisions from the start, rather than becoming a costly surprise mid-project.

Design-Build Handles Everything

A design-build approach means you're not coordinating separate vendors for every phase of the project. One team manages the space plan, material and finish selections, permitting, construction, and even the final cleanup once work wraps. Instead of stitching together a project yourself, you have one company responsible for the whole experience, start to finish.

The Bottom Line

Design-build changes the incentives. When one company is responsible for the design, the budget, and the build, everyone is working toward the same finished space, not just their piece of it.

Ready to see the difference for yourself?

Contact Sicora Design/Build to schedule a free in-home or video consultation and find out what a truly integrated remodeling process looks like.

EXPERT TIPS
How Much Will My Remodel Cost? Here’s How We Figure It Out With You.
How Much Will My Remodel Cost? Here's How We Figure It Out with you.

Short answer: There's no fixed price for a kitchen, bathroom, addition, or whole-home remodel — because no two homes, or homeowners, are the same. What we can tell you is this: your scope and selections can be adjusted to fit your budget at nearly every stage of the process, not just at the very beginning. You have more control over the final number than you might think.

Here's how the process actually works, and where you have room to shape it.

Step One: Visit our pricing guide for a general idea of what things cost.
Step Two: Let’s being with a conversation.

 Feel free to schedule a phone call or a complimentary in home consultation through the Sicora website.

 Step 3: In home consultation-

At this meeting we will learn about your needs and wants while educating you about the opportunities that exist. If possible, we will provide you with an estimate cost of the project, without drawn plans within 10% plus or minus. It's enough to help you decide whether to move forward, without asking you to commit to a real budget for a design that doesn't exist yet.

Step Four: Phase 1 of Design- Explore what’s possible

Fixed Design fee of $3,000- credited to your build project

This is where scope flexibility really starts. Rather than handing you one plan and one price, we build three design concepts — light, medium, and heavy — each with its own estimated cost. Seeing all three lets you decide how much project you actually want, instead of reacting to a single take-it-or-leave-it number.

From there, we spend a couple of meetings refining the drawings and scope until the design fits both your vision and your budget. If a heavier option is out of range, we scale it back. If there's room to do more, we can build toward that too. Nothing is locked in until you're ready.

Step Five: Phase 2 of Design— Bid Walk and Cost Refinement

Fixed Desing fee of $5,000- credited to your build project

Once you've landed on a design, we head to your home for a bid walk with your designer,  project manager and our trade partners — the step that turns your design into a solid price. Even here, scope isn't frozen. We review the budget together and can adjust selections or scope before the contract is signed.

Step 6: Budget and Scope Review- Decide what scope to include in your project, and we will then write and execute your contract!

What Are Allowances and How Do They Affect My Budget?

Once you're under contract, we will finish selections — countertops, plumbing fixtures, lighting, tile — are allowances. Most Sicora clients stay within 5% of established allowances. Industry average is 5-10%. Select a product above the allowance, you pay the difference. Select a product below the allowance, you receive a credit.

Are you going to fleece me with change orders?

We are not here to take advantage of you, but want to help you take care of extra work that you may want to take on. Average Sicora projects finish within 3-5% of the original contract amount.

If something comes up once construction has started, changes go through a written change order process.  Approved change orders adjust your contract price accordingly — so you always know, in writing, exactly what a change costs before it happens.

So What's My Final Price?

Your final project cost comes down to a simple formula:

Final Price = Original Contract Price + Approved Change Orders ± Allowance Adjustments

Every number on that final invoice traces back to a decision you made and approved along the way — not a surprise.

Where Should I Start?

If you're just starting to think about a remodel and want a general sense of what different project types tend to cost, our pricing guide is a good first stop.

Have a specific project in mind?

The best way to get real numbers is to talk it through with us directly. Contact Sicora Design/Build to schedule a free in-home or phone consultation, and we'll help you figure out what your project could look like — and what it could cost.

Discover What’s Possible with Sicora’s Three-Tier Remodel Design Approach

Most homeowners know what isn’t working in their space—but not always how to fix it. At Sicora Design/Build, we help Minneapolis-area homeowners see their homes in new ways. Our three-tier design approach explores light, medium, and heavy options for every project, revealing fresh possibilities for layout, function, and style. From there, we work together to shape a design that fits your goals, your lifestyle, and your budget.

A Smarter, More Transparent Remodeling Experience

To help homeowners understand their home remodeling options, our team creates three custom design concepts that vary in scope and investment. For example, a light kitchen remodel might reimagine your current floor plan, a medium remodel option might include a small addition, and a heavy plan could involve a full expansion.

By seeing all three options side by side, homeowners can mix and match features to create a plan that’s works best for their lifestyle and budget. It’s an empowering process. No surprises, no guesswork, just clear choices backed by honest communication.

Fixed Design Fees for Peace of Mind

Many remodeling firms charge for design work by the hour or offer one free concept as a sales pitch. At Sicora, we work differently. We operate on a fixed design fee, so you can explore ideas freely without worrying about the clock. Our designers collaborate with you until the layout and finishes feel just right, giving you both peace of mind and creative flexibility.

This approach also means you’ll work directly with the designer who will stay with your project through construction, building trust, consistency, and understanding along the way.

From Concept to Completion—All Under One Roof

Our process begins with an in-home visit to measure your space and discuss your goals. From there, our designers create your three options and present them in both floor plans and 3D renderings. These are done in black and white, so the focus stays on layout and flow, without getting distracted by colors or other details that are decided later in the project. When looking at the three options, many clients are pleasantly surprised by what’s possible within their existing footprint, while others decide to go for a larger project scope once they can visualize the finished product.

After reviewing your concepts, we refine and finalize the design that best fits your needs. From there, we move into detailed pricing, selections, and construction. Because Sicora is a true design-build firm, every phase from design and budgeting to build-out and finishing touches is handled by one integrated team.

Why Homeowners Love Our Approach

Homeowners tell us they love having real choices and seeing what their home could be. The process is collaborative and inspiring, and by the end, they not only have a beautiful plan but also the confidence that it fits their vision, budget, and lifestyle.

Whether you’re exploring a kitchen remodel, a bathroom renovation, or a whole-home transformation in the Minneapolis area, Sicora Design/Build makes it simple, transparent, and enjoyable.

Ready to see what’s possible in your home?
Contact Sicora Design/Build today to schedule a free in-home or video consultation and discover how our three-tier approach can bring your vision to life.

1. Introduction

Our website, https://sicora.com (hereinafter: "the website") uses cookies and other related technologies (for convenience all technologies are referred to as "cookies"). Cookies are also placed by third parties we have engaged. In the document below we inform you about the use of cookies on our website.

We do not sell or share personal information to third parties for monetary consideration; however, we may disclose certain personal information to third parties under circumstances that might be deemed a “sale” or ”Sharing” for residents of California (CPRA) and Minnesota (MCDPA). We respect and understand that you may want to be sure that your personal information is not being sold or shared. You may request that we exclude your personal information from such arrangements, or direct us to limit the use and disclosure of possible sensitive personal information, by entering your name and email address below. You may need to provide additional identifying information before we can process your request.

2. Cookies

When you visit our website it can be necessary to store and/or read certain data from your device by using technologies such as cookies.

2.1 Technical or functional cookies

Some cookies ensure that certain parts of the website work properly and that your user preferences remain known. By placing functional cookies, we make it easier for you to visit our website. This way, you do not need to repeatedly enter the same information when visiting our website and, for example, the items remain in your shopping cart until you have paid. We may place these cookies without your consent.

2.2 Statistics cookies

We use statistics cookies to optimize the website experience for our users. With these statistics cookies we get insights in the usage of our website.

2.3 Advertising cookies

On this website we use advertising cookies, enabling us to gain insights into the campaign results. This happens based on a profile we create based on your behavior on https://sicora.com. With these cookies you, as website visitor, are linked to a unique ID but these cookies will not profile your behavior and interests to serve personalized ads.

You can object to the tracking by these cookies by clicking the "Manage Consent" button.

2.4 Marketing/Tracking cookies

Marketing/Tracking cookies are cookies or any other form of local storage, used to create user profiles to display advertising or to track the user on this website or across several websites for similar marketing purposes.

2.5 Social media

On our website, we have included content from Facebook and Instagram to promote web pages (e.g. “like”, “pin”) or share (e.g. “tweet”) on social networks like Facebook and Instagram. This content is embedded with code derived from Facebook and Instagram and places cookies. This content might store and process certain information for personalized advertising.

Please read the privacy statement of these social networks (which can change regularly) to read what they do with your (personal) data which they process using these cookies. The data that is retrieved is anonymized as much as possible. Facebook and Instagram are located in the United States.

3. Placed cookies

Most of these technologies have a function, a purpose, and an expiration period.

A function is a particular task a technology has. So a function can be to "store certain data."
Purpose is "the Why" behind the function. Maybe the data is stored because it is needed for statistics.
The expiration period shows the length of the period the used technology can “store or read certain data."

Miscellaneous

Purpose pending investigation

Consent to service miscellaneous
4. Browser and Device based Consent

When you visit our website for the first time, we will show you a pop-up with an explanation about cookies. You do have the right to opt-out and to object against the further use of non-functional cookies.

5. Enabling/disabling and deleting cookies

You can use your internet browser to automatically or manually delete cookies. You can also specify that certain cookies may not be placed. Another option is to change the settings of your internet browser so that you receive a message each time a cookie is placed. For more information about these options, please refer to the instructions in the Help section of your browser.

Please note that our website may not work properly if all cookies are disabled. If you do delete the cookies in your browser, they will be placed again after your consent when you visit our website again.

6. Your rights with respect to personal data

You have the following rights with respect to your personal data:

you may submit a request for access to the data we process about you;
you may object to the processing;
you may request an overview, in a commonly used format, of the data we process about you;
you may request correction or deletion of the data if it is incorrect or not or no longer relevant, or to ask to restrict the processing of the data.

To exercise these rights, please contact us. Please refer to the contact details at the bottom of this Cookie Policy. If you have a complaint about how we handle your data, we would like to hear from you.

For more information about your rights with respect to personal data, please refer to our Privacy Statement

Pricing Guide

If you’re considering remodeling your home, how much it will cost is probably your number one question. From discussing the feasibility of your project during an initial consultation, to providing multiple design options at different price points, we’ll help you choose options that fit your needs and budget. Check out the ballpark pricing below to learn more.

Designs to Fit Your
Lifestyle and Budget

At Sicora Design/Build, we offer a unique approach to home remodeling providing you with three tailored design plans at different price points. Unlike one-size-fits-all solutions, our approach gives you options, ensuring the best value for your investment. By providing clear choices upfront, we eliminate guesswork and unexpected costs, giving you confidence in your remodeling journey. With Sicora, you can create a home that meets your needs without compromising quality or breaking the bank.

Custom Closet Sytems

Sicora Design/Build brings the same craftsmanship and design expertise behind our remodeling projects to beautifully organized custom closets. Through our cabinetry division, Rift Sawn, we design, craft and install high-quality, customizable closet systems that combine smart functionality with refined style—at a more accessible price point than most luxury closet brands.

contact us
Quality Closet Systems
Handcrafted in Minnesota

Each closet system is thoughtfully designed to fit your space and storage needs. Choose from options including adjustable shelving, drawers, and double or single hanging rods. Your custom closet system will be crafted with care in Minnesota using durable white melamine, and professionally installed by our experienced team. We offer our custom closets three ways: sold directly to homeowners, integrated into Sicora remodeling projects, or provided through B2B partnerships with Rift Sawn. Contact us today and transform the way you organize your space with custom closets designed just for you.

CLOSET OPTIONS to Inspire You
load more

"We couldn't be happier with our experience with Sicora. They not only came up with a beautiful design that solved all of our design concerns, but they executed it on time and on budget. They were with us 100% of the way and treated us like we were their only customers!" 

— JENNY S.
Good to Know
CUSTOM CABINETRY & WOOD WORKING

Rift Sawn is the custom cabinet and woodworking division of Sicora. No project is too big or too small for the Rift Sawn team. Our products include kitchen cabinets, entertainment centers and other built-ins, plus bars, counters, shelving, custom closet organization and much more.
